trigger.note: The storm starts at onset_s (scenario). The incident fires when the on-site dose-rate rule trips, a few seconds later.

Fires when the crew has walked 6 minutes of its solar-storm route. The storm starts at 60 s, the on-site rule raises the alert about 5.5 s later and the crew takes its first step 60 s (reactS) after the alert, so at_s = 60 + 5.5 + 60 + 360 = 485.5. The engine holds the mission clock at that instant, whatever the demo pacing.
One Mars sol after the solar event; the mission clock jumps forward.
